title: Vercel AI Gateway serves Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 free until November 3, 2026
detail: Vercel added InclusionAI's Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 (inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash-1019) to AI Gateway, free until November 3, 2026. Free requests still appear in the spend dashboard with a full request trace. On November 3, requests begin charging at the published rate. The changelog entry does not print that rate.
impact: Traffic routed to this model costs nothing until November 3. After that it bills at a rate the changelog does not state, so check the model page before leaving it in a production path.
